title: Sociobiology for Operators: What the Field Still Offers (and What It Doesn’t)
audience: Professionals who keep hearing evolutionary metaphors in strategy rooms and want a non-crank briefing.
metaDescription: A careful field guide to sociobiology — useful models of status, kinship, and coalitions, plus the history of misuse — for operators who brief others.
angle: Rehabilitate the *useful* toolkit without laundering scientific racism or just-so stories. History of the Wilson controversy → core concepts that survive → how culture desks can use them → hard limits.

dataSources.name: Modern behavioral ecology / evolutionary anthro reviews

sectionPlan.title: THE SURVIVING TOOLKIT
sectionPlan.question: Which models (kin, reciprocal altruism, status) still earn their keep?

sectionPlan.title: HARD LIMITS
sectionPlan.question: Where must culture desks refuse biological metaphor?
